# AXE2 interface control document (generated by rf2/rf2_icd.py; MODELED)

Chassis v2 (rf2_chassis.py). 12 interfaces. Connector parts marked TBD carry the requirement they must meet; the readiness gate P0.1 stays open until every part is verified.

## Checks

- PASS: rule 6: every HV conductor insulated >= 630 V
- PASS: ampacity and pin counts
- PASS: harness nets in rf2_system all defined at the cord's head end (I2)
- PASS: screen FPC bend limit (3 bends) handled by a dynamic hinge flex (I11) and a static panel FPC (I12)
- OPEN: every connector part verified (datasheet on file, ratings read) ({'tbd_or_unverified': ['I3', 'I6']})

- **From / to:** coil (26 t FEP litz) -> TXJ
- **Medium:** litz ends into wire-hole pads, potted
- **Connector:** solder (wire-hole pads), existing TXJ board
- **Status:** built (board:TXJ)

## I3. Coil cord through the telescope (head -> outer-section anchor)

- **From / to:** head gland -> cord board in the hinge knuckle
- **Medium:** custom coil cord in the 18 x 18 mm inner bore: twisted FEP AWG18 1000 V TX pair, AWG20 power pair, 3 twisted AWG26 pairs (TXCMD, TXSTAT, DATA), 3 individually shielded AWG26 REF pairs + drain; PUR jacket; coil OD 17 mm, stretch 4.4 : 1
- **Connector:** none (continuous); vendor TBD (custom: stock PUR cords are 120-500 V, rule 6 needs the TX pair at >= 630 V)

## I5. Hinge pass-through (cord board -> chassis)

- **From / to:** cord board (hinge knuckle) -> TXD (TX pair, TXCMD / TXSTAT) and HB2-M (DATA, VIN_H return)
- **Medium:** clock-spring flex in the hollow hinge axis: unbonded single-sided plies (air-gap), 2 oz copper; TX traces 3 mm wide, >= 1.0 mm spacing (rule 6); 180 deg fold
- **Connector:** Panasonic Y5B FPC ends (50 V, 0.5 A / pin, datasheet on file) on the LV plies; the HV ply soldered to TXD and the cord board
- **Status:** design (P3.3)
